scope: Personal profile visual proposal only; no application or backend changes
direction: Restrained functional layout inspired by Dieter Rams; retain Ninda brand
layout: Two vertically stacked cards; no tabs; single-row identity fields

states.verified: Three readonly rows; corner verified label; no certification CTA or consent checkbox; retain subdued status refresh
states.unverified: Certification action belongs inside personal-information card; keep existing verification conditions and consent
states.documents: Clickable short document labels; replace and remove inline; immediate persisted save with existing failure handling
states.regularCustomer: Driving licence uses the same document-row layout when required
states.virtualAcceptance: This proposal shows the existing virtual-acceptance customer's two identity documents; preserve existing test-scope notice at implementation
